make_builder_mmap: build a MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder to write tensors to an mmap-backed indexed dataset file
make_builder_cached: build an IndexedDatasetBuilder to write tensors to a cached TorchNet indexed dataset file
make_dataset_mmap: create a MMapIndexedDataset from an existing mmap dataset path for memory-mapped data access
make_dataset_cached: create an IndexedCachedDataset from an existing dataset path with optional Lua indexing fix
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from a given file path by reading its magic bytes
